title: IKBD Systems
body:
**Keyboard Operations**
Keyboards use a [[Scan Matrix]] to detect [[Make-Break Codes]] 

The *make* code is the code for the key being pressed *down*
The *break* code is the code for the key being *released*

The Make or break code is referred to as a *scan* code $S$
where
$0 \leq S \leq 127$
